notes.title: [Update Notice] Version 1.1 Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45445828/51fb8698b93177a201835fc473aff7db4daa9fb4.jpg[/img]
Thank you for playing SKETCHY MASSAGE!
We’ve released Version 1.1, which brings the following additions and improvements.

・Replay Feature
You can now record and replay your drag actions on the character.
Press the "Record" button and drag a specific part of the character — your movements will be recorded in real time.
When you release the mouse, the recording is automatically saved and a green "Play" button appears.
Click the button to have the character replay your recorded motion.
Double-clicking allows you to immediately interrupt the playback.

・Cursor Assistant Feature
Previously, the cursor was hidden during drag operations to enhance immersion.
In response to feedback that it made it hard to track the cursor and worsened control,
we’ve added a toggle to show or hide the cursor during dragging.

・Bonus Illustration Added
We’ve added a brand-new bonus illustration!
Be sure to check it out in the game!

・Other Fixes
Bug fixes and translation improvements.

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: 5,000 Downloads Achieved – Free Update Announced!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45445828/8bacb75570a362f1e9386c1628217580fd92c7d3.jpg[/img]

Thank you so much! We've already surpassed 5,000 downloads!
I really wanted more people to pick up and enjoy this game, so I’m incredibly happy.
This is all thanks to your support!

To celebrate, I’m planning a [b]special free update with a brand-new scene[/b]!
Since this is a solo project, it may take a bit of time,
but I’m working on a scene where the thighs will have a much wider range of movement, and you’ll be able to customize breast size, clothing types, and more!

Please look forward to it! 💓

As for "doujin-style censorship" like mosaics and visual edits, I kindly ask for a bit more time.
I’m still new to game development,
not yet fully familiar with Steam’s systems,
and I currently don’t have any partnerships with large international publishers.
But I’m learning and moving forward step by step,
so I’d be very grateful if you could wait just a little longer!
